bagPolicy.summary: At Marlins games, clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 16" x 16" x 8" are allowed, plus small clutches up to 6" x 8".

bagPolicy.note: This is the ballpark bag policy. Prohibited items for non-baseball events are set case by case, so for a concert call (305) 480-1300 at least 10 days before the event to confirm.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at LoanDepot Park can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Rideshare pickup is at East Lot 1, 1380 NW 6th Street. Follow the location shown in your rideshare app.

concessions.note: LoanDepot Park offers a variety of food and drink options, including classic ballpark eats and local Miami cuisine. Highlights include the All-Star Steals menu with affordable pricing and the 3o5 Menu available during home games. Fans can also enjoy mobile food ordering for convenience.
stands: The Change Up powered by Pepsi

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking is available in all four (4) parking garages and two (2) surface parking lots (East Lot 2 & East Lot 3) on a first-come, first-served basis. Wheelchair accessible and semi-ambulatory seats with operable armrests are located in various sections on all ballpark levels.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is prohibited except for emergencies or visits to the New Era Team Store on the West Plaza. Speak to a Guest Experience team member before leaving.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Bag Locker Rentals are located on the North side of loanDepot park in between the North Ticket Office and PNC Club Entrance.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Guests can choose to watch batting practice and infield workouts once doors open 90 minutes prior to first pitch.
